read.thesis: Off-price retailer posted 5% comp and 60bp Q4 gross margin gain on a glutted branded market; inventory per store up 10% and FY27 guide implies only 2-3% comp with EPS $4.93-$5.20.

capex.quote: We expect capital expenditures to be in the range of $2,200,000,000 to $2,300,000,000.

triggers.label: Glutted merchandise market aids buys
triggers.quote: we have the flexibility to bob and weave with a truly glutted market of merchandise

triggers.label: Inventory per store up 10%
triggers.quote: inventory on a per store basis was up 10%

triggers.label: Q4 gross margin up 60bp to 31.1%
triggers.quote: Adjusted gross margin was 31.1%, up 60 basis points over last year's 30.5%.

triggers.label: FY27 comp 2%-3%, EPS $4.93-$5.20
triggers.quote: We are planning overall comp sales growth of 2% to 3%.

guidance.quote: We are planning overall comp sales growth of 2% to 3%.
We are planning full year pretax profit margin to be in the range of 11.7% to 11.8%
we expect it to be in the range of 31.1% to 31.2%.
we are expecting full year diluted earnings per share to be in the range of $4.93 to $5.20
For new stores, we plan to add 146 net new stores
We expect capital expenditures to be in the range of $2,200,000,000 to $2,300,000,000.
in fiscal 2027, we currently expect to buy back $2,500,000,000 to $2,750,000,000

red_flags.label: Inventory per store up 10% vs comp 5%
red_flags.quote: inventory on a per store basis was up 10%

evasions.quote: We are not going to speculate whether they are going to reach Marmaxx levels
It is so early. We are not exactly sure what the vendors are going to do.
